input.title: Senior Software Engineer
input.descriptionText:
Join Tessellate, the infrastructure platform for insurers.

We work in a hybrid model with two days a week in our Shoreditch office.

Please note: you must have the right to work in the UK (we cannot offer sponsorship for this role).

What you'll need
- 6+ years of software engineering experience
- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js
